description: Pro Circle Card by Devlup Funnels is a versatile and dynamic card designed to visually showcase progress or completion using a circular representation. 1. This chart efficiently communicates percentages, making it ideal for displaying task completion, data ratios, or any value that can be represented as a portion of a whole. 2. With adjustable parameters such as size, color, text display, and even animation, developers can seamlessly integrate the Pro Circle Card into various projects. 3. With more than five circle styles to represent data and ability to show five circles in a single card makes it more unique and affective. 4. Ability to modify each specific circle with unique styles.
keywords: Pro Circle Card by Devlup Funnels
